items.text: Updating shows it is working: the button pulses and a bar fills until the new version opens
one box heads the scenes' ticks: ticked when every scene is in play, a dash when some are; ALL / NONE are gone
the Touch tab scrolls on a phone
the tap button keeps one width, so the sound shelf no longer shifts when the tempo shows
the band under an open shelf matches the shelf in light mode
solo lasts one visit: it clears when Current reopens, so a forgotten solo never silences a scene (mute still saves)
"the sound stopped" no longer shows when the silence is your own mix (solo, mute or a level at zero)
Update works on the first tap: it says Updating… and the new version opens within a second or two
when a newer version is out, the index says so in Version, with its own Update button
a pinned Autoplay panel stays open when a Changes gear takes you to its shelf
one solo at a time in the Mixer: soloing a sound moves the solo to it
the bar's Input button wears the ring: it opens the rings, Input first
Fade in the Color ring: how long a color you pick takes to blend in, from a jump to six seconds; it replaces "mine" (your colors stay in the Color panel)
on the iPad home screen, an open shelf reaches the bottom edge of the screen
the preview carries the live fixes for coming back to the app
coming back from another app, the bar and its shelf lay themselves out again for the screen they are on
three fingers hide the controls only on a quick tap, never when the iPad's app-switch gesture passes through
